language.title: Language
language.dirNote: Screens switch direction now; system elements (horizontal lists and Android arrows) follow after the app is reopened once.
language.migrating: Texts are moving to both languages in stages · anything not moved yet appears in Arabic.

lease.scheduleRead: Read from the Ejar file · review it before creating; creating the contract approves it.
lease.scheduleComputedFromFile: Warning: the payment schedule couldn't be read from the Ejar file · the dates below are computed, not read; match them to the file's schedule before creating.
lease.scheduleComputed: Computed from the contract term and payment cycle.
lease.applyBody: Due dates and last payment days in {{n}} contract(s) will be corrected to their files' schedules; amounts and payments stay as they are. Apply?
lease.compareTitle: What was read vs. what exists
lease.compareNote: Tap an item to choose what gets written · empty values are filled by default; different ones only with your approval.
lease.noSlot: No field in the app · shown only
lease.lessorDiffers: The lessor in the contract ({{name}}) differs from the company name · lessor data never overwrites company data.
lease.lessorCrDiffers: The lessor's CR in the contract differs from the company's · lessor data never overwrites company data.

check.count: The schedule has {{actual}} rows; the contract states {{expected}} rent payments
check.regular: A schedule payment ({{actual}}) differs from the regular rent payment ({{expected}})
check.last: The last schedule payment ({{actual}}) differs from the stated last rent payment ({{expected}})

lease.scheduleSumMismatch: The Ejar schedule total {{sum}} differs from the contract total {{total}} · correct the rent, services or parking until they match, or save as draft

assets.title: Assets

memo.cost: Cost of asset “{{name}}” · owner's contribution in kind
memo.convert: Conversion of purchase invoice {{no}} to assets

assets.menuSub: Asset register, book values and depreciation

ui.empty: No assets yet · add one, or convert unit contents or an old purchase invoice from “Tools”.
ui.name: Asset name
ui.newNote: Added “awaiting cost” with no entry or depreciation until its cost comes from a purchase invoice or is entered.
ui.setCostNote: An item without an invoice (owned before the app or brought by the owner): debit the category account, credit capital 3100, with catch-up depreciation since purchase, dated today.
ui.costDone: Cost recorded and its entry posted
ui.transferNote: Depreciation for the days before the transfer stays on the old unit; then cost and accumulated depreciation move to the new one.
ui.disposeNote: Depreciation is posted to the date, then the book value is recorded as a disposal loss (5700). It stays in the register as “disposed”.
ui.sellNote: Depreciation is posted to the date · the difference from book value is a gain (4400) or a loss (5700).
ui.sellDone: Sale recorded and its entry posted

convert.title: Convert an old purchase invoice
convert.pick: Invoices expensed without lines · choose one
convert.previewTitle: Before executing · nothing is written before “Execute”
convert.dated: Entries are dated today, not on the invoice date, so earlier periods don't change.
convert.undoConfirm: Reverses the reclassification, the catch-up and the monthly depreciation of its assets, deletes its assets, and restores the expense.

contents.title: Unit contents to assets
contents.note: Each selected item becomes an asset “in service” and “awaiting cost” with no entry; its description goes to notes · the category is suggested from the name and can be changed.

review.pendingNote: {{n}} asset(s) with no cost or depreciation · record the cost from the Assets screen, or link it to an invoice line.
review.dupNote: Depreciation for {{month}} was posted {{n}} times from more than one device · reverse the extra.

lines.title: Invoice lines
lines.note: Optional · lines that become assets go to their category account at cost plus their tax share; the rest goes to the category expense.
lines.locked: This invoice's assets have depreciation or movements · its lines can't be edited

err.name: Enter the asset name
err.ended: The asset is disposed or sold · no operation is possible
err.pending: The asset is awaiting its cost · record the cost first
err.notPending: The asset's cost is already recorded
err.cost: Enter a cost greater than zero
err.life: Life in months is a whole number from 1 to 600
err.salvage: Residual value must be less than the cost
err.periodClosed: Depreciation for {{month}} is posted · choose a later date
err.beforePurchase: The date is before the asset's purchase date
err.sameUnit: Choose a unit other than its current one
err.lifeLocked: Depreciation has started · life and residual value are locked
err.convertSum: Assets total ({{sum}}) exceeds what the invoice expensed ({{max}})
err.convertEmpty: Mark at least one line as an asset
err.qty: Quantity is a whole number from 1 to 500
err.undoBlocked: An asset from this invoice was transferred, disposed or sold · the conversion can't be reversed
err.linesSum: Lines total ({{sum}}) doesn't equal the amount before tax ({{base}})
err.purchaseLocked: This invoice's assets have depreciation or movements · edit the asset or reverse the conversion

chat.title: Chat
chat.menuSub: Direct and group chats between members
chat.needAccount: Chat works after signing in to an organisation · every chat is between its members
chat.empty: No chats yet · start one with a member
chat.noPeople: No members in the directory yet · a member appears after their first sync
chat.nameOnly: You have no access to this record · name only
chat.attachmentsLater: Photos, files and message notifications work after billing is enabled
chat.linkTitle: Link the message to a record
chat.maintenanceLater: Linking maintenance requests works once they are built
